name: ssm:SendCommand
description: Use ssm:SendCommand to execute commands on a running EC2 instance that has a privileged IAM role attached via an instance profile. The selected payload determines what action to take with the instance role's credentials or IAM permissions. The instance must have the SSM agent installed and the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy (or equivalent) attached to its role.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target EC2 instance must be in the Resource section of the policy

additional.description: Discover available EC2 instances with privileged instance profiles
Identify instances with SSM agent online and ready for commands
Retrieve command output from the executed payload
Alternative method to retrieve command output

admin: EC2 instance must exist and be in running state
EC2 instance must have the SSM agent installed (Amazon Linux 2/2023 and Ubuntu include it by default)
EC2 instance must have an instance profile attached to an IAM role
IAM role must have the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy (or equivalent SSM permissions)
Target EC2 instance must have a role with the permissions needed by the selected payload
lateral: EC2 instance must exist and be in running state
EC2 instance must have the SSM agent installed
EC2 instance must have an instance profile attached to an IAM role
IAM role must have the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy (or equivalent SSM permissions)

techniques: T1552.005 - Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API

options.name: INSTANCE_ID
options.description: Target EC2 instance ID (must have SSM agent running and a privileged instance profile)

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload to execute on the instance (run 'payloads list' to see available options)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region where the target instance runs

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach a policy to an IAM user or role using the instance role's IAM permissions

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create access keys for an IAM user using the instance role's IAM permissions

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges using the instance role's IAM permissions

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges using the instance role's IAM permissions

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Append a trust policy statement to an IAM role using the instance role's IAM permissions

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Exfiltrate instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled HTTPS endpoint via SSM command

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via SSM command

payloads.name: revshell/tls
payloads.description: Establish a TLS-encrypted reverse shell via SSM command

payloads.name: shell/interactive
payloads.description: Open a live interactive shell via the SSM session (no reverse connection required)
